turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm thinking about getting an electric car. Is it a bad idea if I live in a flat?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not necessarily. The main question is where you'd charge it. Is there a charger near your building or at work?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's one at the supermarket down the road.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That can work if you don't drive much. A quick charge while you shop a couple of times a week covers a lot of city driving.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's very doable. Most electric cars would only need charging once or twice a week for that.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Actually, what about a hybrid instead? Less hassle?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A hybrid is a nice middle ground. You'd never worry about charging, though you'd save a bit less on fuel.
